config:
; School booth overrides for IKEMEN GO v1.0.0.
; Reference only. Merge into save/config.ini or launch with -config <path>.
; Source: https://github.com/ikemen-engine/Ikemen-GO/blob/v1.0.0/src/resources/defaultConfig.ini
; Missing settings inherit embedded defaults. Do not append duplicate existing keys.

[Options]
Difficulty = 4
Life = 100
Time = 60
Match.Wins = 2
Match.MaxDrawGames = 1
GameSpeed = 0

[Config]
Motif = data/pangyo/system.def
Players = 2
Language = en
FirstRun = 0
WindowTitle = 판교고 방과후 대전
EscOpensMenu = 1
ScreenshotFolder = screenshots/

[Video]
RenderMode = OpenGL ES 3.2
GameWidth = 1280
GameHeight = 720
WindowWidth = 1280
WindowHeight = 720
Fullscreen = 0
Borderless = 0
WindowCentered = 1
Framerate = 60
VSync = 1
KeepAspect = 1
RGBSpriteBilinearFilter = 0
WindowScaleMode = 0

[Keys_P1]
Joystick = -1
up = w
down = s
left = a
right = d
x = f
y = g
z = h
a = v
b = b
c = n
start = RETURN
d = Not used
w = Not used
menu = Not used

[Keys_P2]
Joystick = -1
up = UP
down = DOWN
left = LEFT
right = RIGHT
x = u
y = i
z = o
a = j
b = k
c = l
start = RSHIFT
d = Not used
w = Not used
menu = Not used

[Netplay]
ListenPort = 7500
RollbackNetcode = 1
Rollback.FrameDelay = 2
Rollback.LogsEnabled = 0
Rollback.DesyncTest = 0
Rollback.DesyncTestFrames = 0

[Common]
Modules = data/pangyo/web-bridge.lua
